question: Do extra frames or higher spatial detail reduce scoring errors without changing prompts, weights or model parameters?
development: Two previously observed failure candidates; not an independent test
selection: Full valid output coverage required; choose strictly lower development macro MAE, ties favor lower pixel budget; keep baseline if no improvement
regression: Previous three diagnostic samples, candidate evaluated only after selection
fresh_check: First unused prompt pair in metadata order, disjoint from every previously used prompt; labels only evaluated after selection. Two samples do not establish generalization.
default_change_gate: Complete candidate outputs; correct development and fresh-check pair direction; regression MAE not worse; fresh-check MAE strictly better. No score overwriting, label-based prompt changes or threshold tuning.
